visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D animation of a hand holding a salt shaker labeled 'SALT' against a soft pink background. A small character logo appears in the top left corner. (2) Transition to a medium shot of a young woman with short brown hair and a red hoodie; she looks neutral as the hand with the salt shaker moves. (3) A purple background appears behind a floating chocolate bar; yellow and white variety-style speech bubbles appear as the character's expression shifts to overwhelmed. (4) The scene cuts back to the girl against a red background with high-contrast motion lines; she looks angry or disgusted while animations of broccoli and cabbage appear next to her. (5) A world map graphic is shown with a highlighted region and percentage text overlays. (6) A close-up scientific diagram of a human mouth and tongue is displayed, with small pink circles representing anatomical structures. (7) Various food items like a lemon, chili pepper, and cucumber appear with red 'X' marks over them as the girl appears in the foreground, shielding her face. (8) A kitchen scene shows a purple pan on a flaming stove with a chemical structure overlay; the girl reappears looking nauseous as a green leaf is dropped into the pan. (9) The girl is shown in a high-arousal state with large yellow variety text 'SUPER!' and 'INVINCIBLE!' around her. (10) The final shot is a split screen with a thumbnail of a real woman sticking her tongue out and call-to-action text with a red arrow pointing down.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins with a professional yet conversational tone, accompanied by an upbeat synth-pop BGM with a clear electronic drum beat. (2) A sharp 'pop' SFX triggers as the chocolate bar appears; the narrator's pitch rises when saying 'sweetened to the max' to emphasize the character's reaction. (3) A loud 'impact' SFX marks the appearance of the broccoli; the narrator's tone becomes more empathetic and informative. (4) A digital 'ding' sound effect occurs as the world map and statistics text appear, signaling the transition to a scientific explanation. (5) Fast whooshing SFX are heard during the quick cuts between the lemon, chili, and cucumber graphics. (6) The narrator explains the term 'fungiform papillae' with high articulation clarity, while the BGM remains a consistent, driving background layer. (7) A percussive 'hit' SFX emphasizes the chemical formula reveal; the narrator uses a slightly lower pitch for the 'don't misunderstand' phrase. (8) The audio concludes with a energetic call to action, featuring a quick synthesizer riser SFX that cuts abruptly at the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Definition -> Biological Explanation -> Practical Implication -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate viewers about the biological phenomenon of 'Supertasters'—individuals with a higher density of taste buds—explaining why some people are extremely sensitive to certain flavors like bitterness in vegetables.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: No products are promoted; the content is purely educational science communication.
